title: Energy added by Lux's [Add][2] ability is unrestricted; the 'Spend this Energy only to play spells' rider is not enforced.
expected: Parser output for ven-sp6-006's text "[Exhaust]: [Reaction] — [Add] [2]. Spend this Energy only to play spells." is `{type:"activated", cost:{exhaust:true}, timing:"reaction", effect:{type:"add-resource", energy:2}}` with no restriction (verified by running parseAbilities). riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/activated.ts:263-269 and :361-366 only recognize "Spend this Energy only during showdowns"; the "only to play spells" rider is silently swallowed by the [Add] regex at :272 (`\.?\s*(?:\(.*\))?` doesn't apply, but parseEffects path strips it). Engine handler riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/add-resource.ts:5-10 does `pool.energy += effect.energy` into the generic rune pool with no spend restriction, so the 2 energy pays for any card. Existing test riftbound-engine/src/__tests__/cards/ogs-014-024.test.ts:58 is marked test.failing("BUG: 'Use only to play spells' ...") documenting the same defect for the OGS printing.
observed: After activating Lux (energy 0->2, all runes still ready), legal moves listed playUnit for every 2-cost unit in hand; executing playUnit on Overzealous Fan (unit, cost 2) succeeded, energy went 2->0 and no runes were exhausted.

history.note: parser: 'Spend this Energy only to play spells' now sets add-resource restriction (engine already enforced it)

resolution.note: parser: 'Spend this Energy only to play spells' now sets add-resource restriction (engine already enforced it)
